title: Developer
lead: Menifee 37: 701 townhome condos north of Rouse Rd, west of Menifee Rd, east of Junipero Rd and south of Case Rd, approved unanimously by the Menifee Planning Commission on Oct 28, 2026, to be built in phases.
notes: Source: Menifee 24/7, Oct 29, 2026 (Planning Commission approval); earlier preview said the project includes about 3,000 ft of off-site storm drain. A few miles from the yard. Developer also talked about tying in two neighboring properties with about 180 more homes. Housing Element issue could bring a City Council follow-up, but ask Bergeron who will do grading, streets and storm drain, and pitch base for the private streets and dumping for any demo.
